app.name: NutriLens
app.tagline: See your food differently. Eat smarter.

landing.hero_subtitle: Turn everyday meals into smarter nutrition decisions. Understand what's on your plate, explore local food prices in Savar and Ashulia, and discover affordable ways to eat better.
landing.problem_title: Why Global Nutrition Apps Fail in Bangladesh
landing.problem_p1: Traditional diet trackers don't understand Bangladeshi food culture. They confuse boiled parboiled rice with dry raw grains and fail to account for mixed curry preparations.
landing.problem_p2: More importantly, nutrition advice is completely detached from the daily bazar. Recommending expensive salmon or quinoa when local Tilapia, eggs, and lentils are available wastes money and undermines health.
landing.steps_title: From Plate Photo to Smart Shopping Basket
landing.step1_desc: Snap a photo of your breakfast, lunch, or dinner. AI identifies local ingredients without guessing authoritative calories.
landing.step2_desc: You verify the food identity, preparation state, and portion size. Sourced nutrition is calculated using verified FAO data.
landing.step3_desc: Compare your meal components against simulated local market prices in Savar and Ashulia.
landing.step4_desc: Receive culturally familiar substitutions that protect your budget, fit your available time, and fulfill your nutrition goals.

analyze.title: Plate Scanner
analyze.subtitle: Upload or drag-and-drop a photo of your meal. We will detect visible food candidates.
analyze.drag_drop: Drag & drop your meal photo here, or click to browse
analyze.consent_notice: By scanning, you confirm you are uploading a food image for non-clinical nutrition estimation.
analyze.or_manual: Or search food manually without a camera
analyze.manual_search_placeholder: Search e.g. Bhat, Masoor Dal, Dim Bhaji...

confirm.title: Review & Confirm Portions
confirm.subtitle: AI proposes candidates, but you know what you served. Adjust grams and preparation before calculating nutrition.

report.title: Nutrition Evidence Receipt
report.subtitle: Deterministic calculation per confirmed 100g edible portion. Missing micronutrients are preserved as unknown.
report.source_fao: FAO Food Composition Table for Bangladesh (2013)

bazar.title: Bazar Intelligence
bazar.subtitle: Commodity pricing and stock levels in local Bangladesh bazars.
bazar.simulated_warning: All prices grounded in official 2026 World Food Programme (WFP) Bangladesh retail data.

meal_rescue.title: Constraint-Aware Meal Rescue
meal_rescue.subtitle: Find affordable, culturally familiar pivots that satisfy your nutrition focus and stay within budget.

shopping.title: Smart Shopping Basket
shopping.subtitle: Aggregated shopping list rounded to local pack quantities with pantry deductions.

profile.title: Profile & Settings
profile.subtitle: Manage your dietary goals, household size, and bazar context.
